name: analyze_stock
description: Run the TradingAgents multi-agent analysis (market, sentiment, news and fundamentals analysts, a bull/bear research debate, a trader and a risk debate) for one stock ticker and return the Portfolio Manager's rating (Buy, Overweight, Hold, Underweight, Sell, or REVIEW when no rating could be read) with the decision text. Read-only: it never places orders. Takes one to several minutes. Research output, not financial advice.

name: get_report
description: Return the saved reports of an earlier analysis run: analyst reports, the bull/bear investment debate, the investment and trader plans, the risk debate and the final decision, each truncated. section narrows it to one of: market, sentiment, news, fundamentals, investment_debate, investment_plan, trader_plan, risk_debate, final_decision. Reads saved files only; never re-runs the analysis.

name: get_run_metrics
description: Return the recorded metrics of an earlier run: E1 routing and backup-model events, E2 cache counts, E3 token usage and per-agent figures, estimated cost (an estimate, not provider billing), per-run limits, errors and timing. Reads saved files only; makes no model or market-data request.

name: list_recent_runs
description: List recent saved analysis runs, newest first, with run ID, ticker, trade date, source, status, rating and summary figures. limit: 1 to 50 (default 10).

name: propose_trade
description: Say what paper trade the F1 rules would allow for an earlier run's rating (a buy, a sell only to reduce a long position, or no trade, with the reason and the order rules). Read-only: it never approves, signs, submits, cancels or executes an order; a signed-in person decides in the TradingAgents dashboard. Research output, not financial advice.
